name: Overdrive: Whirlwind Grand Prix
description: The brand-new racing grand prix in Astropolis will emulate the "Phantasmoon Games." The sole winning team will ascend to godhood and become the "God of Traffic (Laws)."
introduction:
◆ Introduction ◆
● The brand-new racing grand prix in Astropolis will emulate the "Phantasmoon Games." The sole winning team will ascend to godhood and become the "God of Traffic (Laws)."

◆ Event Rules ◆
● In "Overdrive: Whirlwind Grand Prix," the Trailblazer will act as a team principal, leading the racing team to win the championships of the Astropolis Cup and the Cosmic Cup.
● During the grand prix, recruit drivers via Race Highlights and obtain car parts via R&D Nodes to enhance your racecars' competitiveness in the main races.

◆ Permanent Rewards ◆
● Achieve a cumulative number of race victories to obtain rewards in the Champion's Path.

◆ Limited-Time Rewards ◆
● During the limited-time event, achieve a cumulative number of race victories to obtain a Light Cone and its Superimposition material rewards.
● During the limited-time event, completing specified mission objectives will earn you corresponding rewards.

◆ Event Reminders ◆
● After the "Overdrive: Whirlwind Grand Prix" limited-time event ends, Trailblazers will no longer be able to obtain the limited-time rewards, but they can still visit the Pit Stop in the Astropolis Central District map to experience the event and obtain permanent rewards.
